Silent Aim — Automatically redirects shots toward a selected target without moving your visible aim.

Show FOV — Displays the targeting area used by Silent Aim.

Target FOV — Sets the size of the targeting area.

Target Selection — Chooses how targets are prioritized.

Kill Aura — Automatically attacks enemies within range.

Silent Targeting — Selects targets without visibly locking onto them.

Boss / Special Only — Targets only bosses or special enemies.

360 Targeting — Allows attacks in every direction around the player.

Ignore Minions — Excludes weaker enemies from targeting.

Target Range — Maximum distance at which enemies can be targeted.

Insta Kill All — Continuously attempts to instantly eliminate all valid targets.

Kill All Once — Performs a single attack against all valid targets.

Player ESP — Displays players through walls or obstacles.

Highlight — Adds outlines or highlights to entities.

Name — Shows entity names.

Health — Shows health information.

Distance — Shows distance information.

Ignore Same Team — Hides teammates from ESP.

Max Distance — Maximum ESP rendering distance.

Fill Transparency — Controls ESP opacity.

Refresh Player ESP — Reloads player ESP tracking.

Zombie ESP — Displays zombies through walls or obstacles.

Refresh Zombie ESP — Reloads zombie ESP tracking.

Boss ESP — Displays bosses through walls or obstacles.

Refresh Boss ESP — Reloads boss ESP tracking.

Auto Buy Better Weapon — Automatically purchases stronger weapons when available.

Buy Better Weapon — Manually purchases a stronger weapon.

Auto Buy Health — Automatically purchases health upgrades.

Buy Health Upgrade — Manually purchases a health upgrade.

Gear Automation — Enables automatic use of equipment and abilities.

Auto Deadeye — Automatically activates the Deadeye ability.

Auto Target Mark — Automatically marks enemies.

Auto StimShot — Automatically uses StimShot items or abilities.

Auto Healing Station — Automatically deploys healing stations.

Use Deadeye — Manually activates Deadeye.

Use Target Mark — Manually marks a target.

Drone ESP — Displays drones through walls or obstacles.

Health Display — Shows drone health.

Show Target — Shows the drone's current target.

Auto Buy / Spawn — Automatically purchases or spawns drones.

Buy Drone — Manually purchases or spawns a drone.
